components.css: :host{--navy:#1a1c95;--navy-ink:#0b0c45;--blue:#0072ce;--sky:#00a8e8;--paper:#fff;--paper-2:#f2f5fa;--rule:#d9e0ec;--ink-2:#3d4270;--muted:#5a6185;--r:8px;--font-display:'Noto Kufi Arabic Variable','Noto Kufi Arabic','Segoe UI',Tahoma,sans-serif;--font-text:'Readex Pro Variable','Readex Pro','Segoe UI',Tahoma,sans-serif}.ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:50px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:var(--r);border:2px solid transparent;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:15.5px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s,color .2s,box-shadow .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn-primary{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 12px 28px -14px rgba(11,12,69,.28)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:3px}.ds-btn svg{transition:transform .25s}.ds-btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(-4px)}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Contact form field with Kufi label and reserved error line.
components.css: :host{--navy:#1a1c95;--navy-ink:#0b0c45;--blue:#0072ce;--sky:#00a8e8;--paper:#fff;--paper-2:#f2f5fa;--rule:#d9e0ec;--ink-2:#3d4270;--muted:#5a6185;--r:8px;--font-display:'Noto Kufi Arabic Variable','Noto Kufi Arabic','Segoe UI',Tahoma,sans-serif;--font-text:'Readex Pro Variable','Readex Pro','Segoe UI',Tahoma,sans-serif}.ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;font-family:var(--font-text)}.ds-field span{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--navy-ink)}.ds-field input{min-height:50px;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:var(--r);border:2px solid var(--rule);background:var(--paper);outline:0;font:inherit;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#aab4cc}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:var(--navy-ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,114,206,.2)}.ds-field small{min-height:1.5em;visibility:hidden;color:#c62f35;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}

components.description: Header navigation drawn as a line of stations; the current page is filled.

components.name: Station
components.description: Map station: ring on its line with a Kufi label; selected fills with the line colour.
components.css: :host{--navy:#1a1c95;--navy-ink:#0b0c45;--blue:#0072ce;--sky:#00a8e8;--paper:#fff;--paper-2:#f2f5fa;--rule:#d9e0ec;--ink-2:#3d4270;--muted:#5a6185;--r:8px;--font-display:'Noto Kufi Arabic Variable','Noto Kufi Arabic','Segoe UI',Tahoma,sans-serif;--font-text:'Readex Pro Variable','Readex Pro','Segoe UI',Tahoma,sans-serif}.ds-line{position:relative;display:flex;gap:56px;padding:0 24px}.ds-line::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:8px;inset-inline:0;height:8px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--sky)}.ds-st{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:0;background:none;padding:0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--navy-ink);cursor:pointer}.ds-st i{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);border:4px solid var(--navy-ink);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-st span{padding:1px 8px;border-radius:4px}.ds-st:hover i{transform:scale(1.15)}.ds-st:hover span{background:var(--paper-2)}.ds-st.is-on i{background:var(--sky);transform:scale(1.15)}.ds-st.is-on span{background:var(--navy-ink);color:#fff;font-weight:700}

components.css: :host{--navy:#1a1c95;--navy-ink:#0b0c45;--blue:#0072ce;--sky:#00a8e8;--paper:#fff;--paper-2:#f2f5fa;--rule:#d9e0ec;--ink-2:#3d4270;--muted:#5a6185;--r:8px;--font-display:'Noto Kufi Arabic Variable','Noto Kufi Arabic','Segoe UI',Tahoma,sans-serif;--font-text:'Readex Pro Variable','Readex Pro','Segoe UI',Tahoma,sans-serif}.ds-key{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:6px 24px;padding:12px 16px;border:2px solid var(--navy-ink);border-radius:var(--r);font-family:var(--font-text);font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-2)}.ds-key ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:4px}.ds-key ul:first-child{padding-inline-end:24px;border-inline-end:1px solid var(--rule)}.ds-key li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.ds-key ul:first-child li{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;color:var(--navy-ink)}.ds-key i{width:26px;height:6px;border-radius:6px}.ds-key .s1{background:var(--sky)}.ds-key .s2{background:var(--navy)}.ds-key em{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--font-text);font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)}.ds-key b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:800;color:var(--navy-ink)}

narrative.overview:
The site is drawn as a printed schematic transit map of the company. Two lines carry the two audiences: the individuals line in sky and the businesses line in navy. Their stations are the insurance products. Both lines bend into a services interchange (forms and claims) and continue as one trunk to a terminus where the visitor reaches a person. Every surface reuses that grammar at its own scale: the header is a line of stations, inner pages open on a band of their line's colour, product pages are strip maps, the claim journey is a route, the closing band is the end of the line, and the footer is the map key.

The sheet is white and the structure is drawn, not boxed. Lines, rings, bullets and 2px ink frames carry hierarchy. Colour commits at the scale of whole regions (route-header bands, the navy terminus, the ink footer) and as line colour, never as scattered accents. The voice is Arabic first and right-to-left: geometric Kufi lettering for every name a visitor navigates by, a calm readable sans for everything they read.

There is no photography, and the world needs none: the products, figures and routes are the content. Motion is a single authored moment, the selection halo gliding along its line.
keyCharacteristics: White map sheet; thick round-capped lines (8px) in the three brand blues.
Stations as white rings with ink outlines; the selected station fills with its line colour.
Line bullets (filled circles with the line number) name every line wherever it appears.
Noto Kufi Arabic for names, headings and labels; Readex Pro for text.
Bands of line colour own whole regions; borders and rules, not shadows, carry structure.
One authored motion: the halo that glides to the chosen station.

rules.name: The Line Colour Rule
rules.body: Sky always means individuals, navy always means businesses, blue always means services. A colour never changes meaning between pages.

rules.name: The Gradient Is The Trunk Rule
rules.body: The logo gradient appears only in the logo, the services trunk leaving the interchange, and the head-office track. It is never a fill for buttons, text or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Sky Is Not Ink Rule
rules.body: Coast Sky fails contrast as text on white; it is used for lines, bullets, swatches and bands with ink text on top.

rules.name: The No Tracking Rule
rules.body: Arabic is never letter-spaced; spacing breaks the joins.

rules.name: The Kufi Names Rule
rules.body: Anything a visitor navigates by (stations, lines, pages, actions) is set in Kufi. Sentences are set in Readex.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Phone numbers, years and counts use tabular figures in an isolated left-to-right run (the `num` utility).

rules.name: The Frame Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface earns a 2px ink frame before it earns a shadow; shadows never stand alone as decoration.

dos: **Do** draw new sections in the line grammar: a line in its audience's colour, ring stations, a line bullet beside the name.
**Do** keep sky for individuals, navy for businesses and blue for services on every page (The Line Colour Rule).
**Do** set every navigable name in Noto Kufi Arabic and every sentence in Readex Pro, with no letter-spacing.
**Do** frame operable surfaces with 2px Map Ink and 8px corners before reaching for a shadow.
**Do** reserve space for error and status text so state changes never move controls.
**Do** theme the browser surfaces: selection, caret, scrollbar, focus ring and tabular figures come from the palette.
donts: **Don't** use the logo gradient as a fill for buttons, text or backgrounds.
**Don't** set Coast Sky as text on white.
**Don't** add eyebrow labels above headings, gradient text, scroll-reveal entrances or a preloader.
**Don't** put a decorative icon beside every station name; on a line, the station is the marker.
**Don't** place map dots for branch locations until the company supplies real ones.
